reviewer.method: Actual inspection through view_image of complete PNGs or labeled contact sheets; original follow-up for small impulse subjects.
reviewer.independence: Reviewer did not run or modify the capture harnesses or product code during this task; this is an AI visual review, not a claimed human sign-off.

summary: All 35 PNGs in the six completed browser gates were actually inspected. No blocking visual rendering or layout concern was observed in these captured states.

Five viewer PNGs were inspected directly; the remaining 30 PNGs were inspected as complete labeled three-frame contact sheets, with all six impulse P04/P11 PNGs additionally inspected at original resolution.
The three legacy visual-browser captures lack hashes in their browser report; their actual bytes, SHA256 and pixel dimensions are bound here. The other 32 capture hashes agree with their report.
Side-view occlusion and small-subject frames constrain visual coverage. These are retained as evidence limitations.
nonblocking_visibility_limitations: Surface side views overlap multiple components, limiting component-by-component observation from those views.
Impulse P04/P11 use a broad scene; fine details are not reliably assessable from the small subjects.
claim_boundaries: Report statuses and metadata are quoted from the identified reports; the reviewer did not reproduce their functional or numerical checks.
The inspection covers only captured views and reported times, not intervening playback or controls in use.
These screenshots show browser playback of recorded transforms. They do not establish live physics, Blender/Unreal import, full language conformance, release readiness or general rendering quality.
Fixture labels are scoped to each gate. The impulse fixture P11 here is not evidence resolving the historical planar-reach P11 failure.
No product import, runtime, test, source edit or remote mutation was performed by this review. Raw PNGs were not modified.
